blocks.goal: Introduce a small helper class to host Elements' private helper logic (siblings and childNodesOfType). Keep the existing Elements class unchanged in this step.

ops.details: Create a new helper class org.jsoup.select.ElementsHelper in the same package. The class provides two package-visible static methods mirroring the behavior of the current private helpers in Elements: siblings(Elements elements, String query, boolean next, boolean all) and <T extends org.jsoup.nodes.Node> List<T> childNodesOfType(Elements elements, Class<T> tClass). Implementation should be a near-copy of the existing private methods, but accept the calling Elements instance as the first parameter. Add necessary imports: java.util.ArrayList, java.util.List, java.util.HashSet/LinkedHashSet only if used; use org.jsoup.nodes.Node and org.jsoup.nodes.Element and org.jsoup.select.Selector/Evaluator as needed. Do not modify Elements.java in this op.

blocks.goal: Move the two private helper methods from Elements into ElementsHelper and update all call sites in Elements to use the new static helper methods without changing any public API.

inputs: src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Elements.java::private Elements siblings(@Nullable String query, boolean next, boolean all)
ops.details: Remove the private siblings(...) method from Elements and keep its implementation in ElementsHelper as a package-visible static method with signature: static Elements siblings(Elements elements, @Nullable String query, boolean next, boolean all). The implementation should use the provided Elements parameter instead of 'this'.

Remove the private childNodesOfType(...) method from Elements and keep its implementation in ElementsHelper as a package-visible static method with signature: static <T extends org.jsoup.nodes.Node> List<T> childNodesOfType(Elements elements, Class<T> tClass). The implementation should iterate over the provided Elements parameter rather than 'this'.

Update all internal calls inside Elements that invoked the removed private helpers to call the new ElementsHelper static methods, passing 'this' as the first argument. Specifically: replace calls to siblings(query, next, all) with ElementsHelper.siblings(this, query, next, all); replace calls to childNodesOfType(X.class) with ElementsHelper.childNodesOfType(this, X.class). Ensure no public method signatures change and Elements remains in the same package so no import is required.
